description: Check the business's own website again, with the same rules as OnHand's free check: at most 5 requests, robots.txt obeyed, and limits per business, per website and overall. The report is linked to the business and replaces the latest one, so the answer is the same shape as get_visibility_report with the new score. Only for a website the business has verified on OnHand; owner, admin or operator. Takes about half a minute; it reads only that website. Requires company:write; the account selects the business.
name: run_visibility_check
title: Check my website again
